snippet.title: CloserLook VR: Oldways - Official Trailer | Game Devs of Color Expo 2025
snippet.description: CloserLook VR: Oldways is a story-driven VR adventure set in modern-day West Africa. Trapped in a university building, explore secret locations, solve puzzles, and uncover a gripping narrative of exploitation, corruption, and betrayal. Watch the CloserLook VR: Oldways trailer to see what to expect from this upcoming game. CloserLook VR: Oldways will be available on Meta and Steam VR, and a demo is out now.
